reviews.comment: Dr. Tinker is super awesome, I learned a lot in her class. The lectures are super short and the rest of the class is just group projects. You do have to read the text book to do well on the 5 question quizzes. She gives you questions to review for exams. She's a really caring teacher! She also brings snacks every class!

Amazing professor very accessible in and out of class. One major group construction project and quizzes and exams here and there. She is a very kind lady and gives opportunity to make up work if appropriate to.

Professor Tinker genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. If your looking for a good professor (who also brings snacks) I would totally take this course. Yes, you have to show up and try, but she does offer extra credit and is really understanding.

I went through a very difficult time in my life while taking her course. It involved months of legal action and emotional distress. Tinker and all my other professors were aware of this. I went to tinker in person asking for makeup assignments and she refused and claimed I just didn't come to class because I didn't want to. I ended up with a D.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Good professor, she runs class differently from other professors, but it can help you understand things better. Lots of group work.

The GOAT. She's super cool and very caring towards her students and wants everyone to do well. She brings snacks every class period and has lots of EC. There are four exams, not hard just study, assignments every class, but with a group, and quiz's that are usually 5 questions every now and then. This class was so easy, take TINKER!   I made a 102.
